trans-unit.target: TEXT_REGFIM7V6E2VISNA_00990_VISNA_000_000<tab>Ahhh, what a lovely breeze! Hopefully it'll be smooth sailing from here.

TEXT_REGFIM7V6E2VISNA_00990_VISNA_000_001<tab>One time, we found an isle that was worth a fortune, but on the way back, we were attacked by thralls. There were so many of them, we had no choice but to cut the isle loose...
TEXT_REGFIM7V6E2VISNA_00990_VISNA_000_002<tab>With you and yours here, though, I'm sure we can handle anything!
TEXT_REGFIM7V6E2VISNA_00990_VISNA_000_100<tab><var 1A 02 /var>Naglfar<var 1A 01 /var> has come into sight, so we're making solid progress, but there's still a fair way to go.
TEXT_REGFIM7V6E2VISNA_00990_VISNA_000_101<tab>To pass the time, I might try crafting a new kind of runework based on the curious things in your possession!
TEXT_REGFIM7V6E2VISNA_00990_VISNA_000_200<tab>The end of the voyage is nigh! Behold our home, the realmship of water─<var 1A 02 /var>Naglfar<var 1A 01 /var>!

TEXT_REGFIM7V6E2VISNA_00990_VISNA_000_201<tab>Soon, we'll have to make the preparations to hand off the isle. While we see to that, you and your friends can get ready to board <var 1A 02 /var>Naglfar<var 1A 01 /var>!
